en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small rural settlement in a hilly, forested area. In the foreground is a large half‑timbered house with a steep tiled roof and multiple chimneys, typical of Central European architecture. Several other detached houses with similar roofs are scattered across the valley and low hills. Dense coniferous forest surrounds the clearing, and rocks and tree stumps are visible in the foreground, suggesting recent clearing of land. There is no visible printed caption or border text on the image side.
